item.description: Strong earnings growth and undemanding valuations are among the reasons keeping risk assets resilient to a more challenging inflation backdrop, according to HSBC Holdings Plc strategists.

item.description: Investors are “far too complacent” on the Additional Tier 1 bonds, the riskiest type of bank debt, and spreads now appear too tight, according to investors at Man Group.

item.title: Centene Boosts Guidance, Reports Favorable Medical Costs

item.title: South Africa to Free 7.1 Billion Rand for Municipalities, Warns More Cuts Possible
item.description: South Africa’s Finance Minister Enoch Godongwana said the National Treasury will not hesitate to again withhold funding from municipalities that fail to improve their financial management, after approving the release of 7.1 billion rand ($423 million) in previously withheld allocations.

item.title: Elevate Campuses Said to Launch $267 Million India IPO in August
item.description: Hillhouse Investment Management Ltd.-backed Elevate Campuses Ltd. is preparing to launch its 25.55-billion rupee ($267 million) initial public offering as early as August, according to people familiar with the matter, paving the way for India’s first listed operator of student dorms.

item.description: Singapore’s central bank warned that uncertainty over sustaining massive AI investments is a key risk for global growth and financial markets, citing this along with the threat of a prolonged re-escalation of the war in the Middle East.

item.title: Treasuries Set for Third Day of Gains as Oil Drops on Iran Talks

item.title: Indian Tax Crackdown Threatens to Slow Exports of Low-Grade Ore

item.title: StanChart Sees Exit of Several Top Wealth Executives in India

item.title: European Stocks Rise as Unilever, Safran Results Boost Sentiment

item.title: UAE: Dubai’s Financial Hub DIFC Tops 10,000 Firms Despite War Risks
item.description: Dubai’s financial hub topped 10,000 active registered companies for the first time, underscoring the emirate’s continued success in attracting global firms despite a period of heightened geopolitical tensions in the region.

item.title: Unite Eyes Sale of 20,000 Beds in Pivot to Top Universities
